release_notes: Build 100 finishes the duplicate Quiz History path resolver with a stable global one-to-one assignment planner.
Duplicate rows are no longer decided independently when several rows compete for several valid C: or Z: project folders.
The planner maximizes the number of recovered History rows first, then maximizes total identity evidence across the whole duplicate set.
Every proposed pair is stress-tested by forbidding that pair and recalculating the best global assignment. Swappable or near-tied mappings remain unresolved instead of being guessed.
A locally second-best folder can now be selected when that produces a stronger and complete one-to-one mapping for the overall set.
The same destination folder can never be assigned to two Quiz History rows.
Build 99 quiz-family protection remains enforced, so Space cannot cross-match General Knowledge and Logos/Icons remain the intentional alias.
Explicit and trusted trailing episode conflicts remain hard No-match conditions.
Duplicate-path repair remains database-only. It does not move, copy, rename, overwrite or delete C: or Z: files.
Archive completed C keeps the faster preview and live C: to Z: copy/verify progress once duplicate-path repair is complete.
The Windows suite includes global assignment, maximum-cardinality, tied-assignment, contested-folder, family and episode safety regressions.
